description: First-run screens from the user's HA (#23): seedConfig(snapshot, tail = []) → toYaml. Reference: emulator/src/core/seed.ts; firmware core/seed.cpp. snapshot = energy/get_prefs (energy) + logical ids with a source (live) + the SEED_TEMPLATE answer (present, areas, climate, lights, sensors). report = the seed report (#89; firmware seedReportJson, compact JSON in this key order).

cases.name: empty
cases.description: An HA with nothing the display knows: only the clock (no "—" tiles, no Travel / House apps).
cases.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
apps:
  - id: home
    title: Home
screens:
  - id: overview
    app: home
    title: Home
    widgets:
      - {type: clock, cs: 2}

cases.name: stranger-house
cases.description: Fake HA --house stranger: P1 meter (grid only: stat_rate sensor.p1_meter_power becomes the home use tile), Nest thermostat, lights, room thermometers. NAS and phone temperatures are not rooms; "Office: upstairs" loses its colon in the label. Clutter of a real install (#58): sensors without device_class / unit / area, an unavailable hallway thermometer (no Hallway room), text states.

cases.name: demo-house
cases.description: Fake HA --house demo (the emulator data): HA has the logical ids themselves (no labels: the catalog tiles), Energy dashboard price entity, tado zones, lights. No sensor.x4_route_* → no Travel app (the demo's routes are emulator mock data); one room thermometer → no Rooms screen.

cases.name: dutch-house
cases.description: Fake HA --house dutch (#82, shaped like the first real HA): no Energy dashboard. Names and units find SolarEdge (Zonproductie, not the Anker PV input), the P1 net power (not phase 1), Anker home load (Huisverbruik), Anker battery power and SOC % (not the kWh capacity, the phone, iPad, Zigbee, P1 Wi-Fi or tado heating %), Zon vandaag, Buienradar outside, tado rooms. No meters → no Energy screen, no charts.

cases.name: dutch-house-energy
cases.description: Fake HA --house dutch-energy: the same house with an Energy dashboard of meters only (HA < 2025.12, no stat_rate). Power sensors come from the meters' entity-id prefix (solaredge_i1_ac → ac_power, p1_meter, anker_solix); charts appear.

cases.name: real-house
cases.description: Fake HA --house real, the large example house (#88, #136): ~1100 entities. Zigbee chip temperatures (`…_device_temperature`) and one-phase power sensors are not in the answer; rooms and inside are real thermometers, outside the Shelly H&T "Outdoor". Envoy: stat_rate production = solar, current_power_consumption = home use, energy_production_today = solar today (`…_last_seven_days` has no day token). Energy dashboard grid flows have no today sensor and Envoy consumption is no grid import → no imported / exported tiles. The Tesla climate (its device has a device_tracker) is a vehicle: the zoneList names the 6 tado zones. #152 traps: a "Forecast Max temperature today" is no Outside; the dryer plug's "Today consumption" is no Imported / Used today (Used today = the "Home energy usage today" helper); the Better-Thermostat-style wrapper (same room and name, off) is no zone; lights: per room the Hue group (not the second HA group of the living room), bulbs where a room has no group, the two lights without an area left out.

cases.name: seed-lessons
cases.description: #152: no outdoor thermometer but forecast-like ones (max, min, feels, Today tokens) → Outside is the first weather entity with a temperature (rule found), the forecast sensors are no room either; an appliance's day counter is no Imported (needs a grid word) and no Used today (needs a house / total word); a grid-named one is; zones: duplicates by area (the one not off wins, in the first one's place) and by friendly name (case-insensitive), a lone off zone stays; lights: only area-less ones left out → `areas`.
cases.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
apps:
  - id: home
    title: Home
  - id: house
    title: House
screens:
  - id: overview
    app: home

    widgets:
      - {type: clock, cs: 2}
      - {type: stat, entity: sensor.lr_temp, label: Inside}
      - {type: stat, entity: weather.home, label: Outside}
  - id: energy

      - {type: stat, entity: sensor.p1_energy_consumption_today, label: Imported}
  - id: lights

  - id: climate
    app: house

    widgets:
      - {type: zoneList, entities: climate.lr_trv climate.k2 climate.attic, cs: 4, rs: 2}
  - id: rooms
    app: house

    widgets:

      - {type: stat, entity: sensor.kit_temp, label: Kitchen}

template: {# x4_seed #}{% set ns = namespace(a=[], l=[], s=[], c=[], v=[], w=[], t=0, p=0, e=0, b=0) %}{% for a in areas() %}{% set ns.a = ns.a + [[a, area_name(a) or a]] %}{% endfor %}{% for s in states.light %}{% if ns.l | length < 150 %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [[s.entity_id, area_id(s.entity_id) or '', 'g' if s.attributes.get('entity_id') or s.attributes.get('is_hue_group') or s.attributes.get('is_deconz_group') or s.attributes.get('lights') else '']] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for s in states.sensor %}{% set dc = s.attributes.get('device_class') or '' %}{% set u = s.attributes.get('unit_of_measurement') or '' %}{% set n = (s.entity_id ~ ' ' ~ (s.name | string)) | lower %}{% set k = 't' if dc == 'temperature' and not ('device_temperature' in n or 'device temperature' in n) else '' if dc == 'temperature' else 'p' if (dc == 'power' or u in ['W', 'kW']) and not ('phase' in n or 'fase' in n or '_l1' in n or '_l2' in n or '_l3' in n) else '' if dc == 'power' or u in ['W', 'kW'] else 'e' if (dc == 'energy' or u in ['kWh', 'Wh']) and n | regex_search('(^|[^a-z0-9])(today|vandaag|daily|dag|day)([^a-z0-9]|$)') else 'b' if u == '%' and dc in ['battery', ''] else 'r' if s.entity_id.startswith('sensor.x4_route_') else '' %}{% if k == 't' and (s.state in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] or ns.t >= 60) %}{% set k = '' %}{% endif %}{% if k == 't' %}{% set ns.t = ns.t + 1 %}{% elif k == 'p' %}{% if ns.p < 100 %}{% set ns.p = ns.p + 1 %}{% else %}{% set k = '' %}{% endif %}{% elif k == 'e' %}{% if ns.e < 40 %}{% set ns.e = ns.e + 1 %}{% else %}{% set k = '' %}{% endif %}{% elif k == 'b' %}{% if ns.b < 60 %}{% set ns.b = ns.b + 1 %}{% else %}{% set k = '' %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% if k %}{% set ns.s = ns.s + [[s.entity_id, dc | string, (area_id(s.entity_id) or '') if k == 't' else '', s.name | string, u | string]] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for s in states.climate %}{% set d = device_id(s.entity_id) %}{% if d and device_entities(d) | select('match', 'device_tracker') | list %}{% set ns.v = ns.v + [s.entity_id] %}{% else %}{% set ns.c = ns.c + [[s.entity_id, s.name | string, area_id(s.entity_id) or '', s.state]] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for s in states.weather %}{% if s.attributes.get('temperature') is number %}{% set ns.w = ns.w + [s.entity_id] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ {'areas': ns.a, 'climate': ns.c, 'vehicles': ns.v, 'lights': ns.l, 'sensors': ns.s, 'weather': ns.w} | tojson }}
answers_description: seedAnswerOk(text): only a JSON object is a seed answer; anything else saves nothing and retries on the next link (#58).
events_description: templateEventFinal(has_result, level): render_template with report_errors; a WARNING event (undefined attribute) is followed by the result (#58). level null = absent.
